title: Design System: Groovectl app UI kit

headline.purpose: Collection title at wide and panel widths.

metadata.purpose: Artist, album, duration and supporting detail.

button.purpose: Primary, secondary and quiet action labels.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Button background/press and icon-button background/text transitions.

motion.name: artwork-hover
motion.purpose: Small artwork lift; disabled by reduced-motion preference.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Applied to kit elements and pseudo-elements when reduced motion is requested.

depth.strategy: Tonal surfaces and fine dividers; no component box-shadow tokens.

excluded: Legacy imperative Studio form styling, including eyebrows
scope.tokenBoundary: Only observed app primitives are recorded. No synthesized tonal ramps or replacement palette are introduced.

behavior.identity: source plus ID; no inferred catalog substitution
behavior.selection: explicit local handoff to Studio, maximum 200; no implicit playback or Apple Music write
behavior.queue: Cider plus advertised get_playback_queue; later profile exclusion closes the dialog; read-only current order
behavior.footer: ResizeObserver sets --groovectl-player-height; library clearance adds 24px and tray gap adds 8px
behavior.unknowns: Metadata, time, volume and unsupported detail remain explicit unknown/unavailable states

qualification.documentationEvidence: Current source and supplied synthetic-host screenshots; not a new test receipt.
qualification.finishReview: Parent-supplied scoped ship verdict after queue/process fixes; no material visual defects reported.
qualification.cardComparison: Unqualified: no QUALITY BAR card or concept roll for this user-pinned code-led extension.
qualification.actualHost: Real ChatGPT/Codex expanded MCP App host and live account/player paths remain separately qualified.
qualification.notCanonized: Legacy Studio eyebrows remain outside reusable app rules.

narrative.northStar: A collection becomes material for a mixtape
narrative.overview:
Groovectl’s app kit makes exact recordings easy to inspect, select and carry into Studio. It inherits the compact wordmark, raspberry selection and host-aware neutral surfaces already used by the app. System UI type, Lucide line icons, square artwork and aligned rows keep a music collection readable at desktop, panel and phone widths.

This document records the implemented Svelte slice in ui/components, CollectionBrowser.svelte, QueuePanel.svelte and kit.css. It does not replace the website system in the repository-root DESIGN.md. Studio’s existing imperative forms remain outside this migration; their older eyebrow styling and larger heading scale are not reusable kit rules. The account-free gallery uses the same components with synthetic music and actions.
keyCharacteristics: Raspberry marks selection, focus and the primary handoff action.
Neutral surfaces, fine dividers and spacing organize content without raised cards.
Recording source identity, selection and playback remain separate.
The optional inspector and persistent player adapt to available width and capabilities.

rules.name: The Selection Rule
rules.body: Selection uses the accent and tint together, with a check, current-state attribute or outline as an additional cue. Color alone does not carry the selected state.

rules.name: The Measured Footer Rule
rules.body: Reserve space from the observed footer height. Keep the selection tray above the player and keep keyboard targets clear of the sticky header and fixed footer.

rules.name: The Exact Recording Rule
rules.body: Keep source plus ID intact when a recording moves to Studio. Browsing, opening details and selecting a recording do not request playback or an Apple Music write.

rules.name: The Capability Rule
rules.body: Render actionable controls from the current player and tool capabilities. Missing metadata, time, volume or resource relationships remain explicit unavailable states.

dos: Do reuse the Svelte controls and scoped kit styles for new app surfaces.
Do keep the reading source, recording identity and controlled player visible in their appropriate contexts.
Do keep selection and targeted playback as separate labeled actions.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced motion and measured player clearance at narrow widths.
Do use the original gallery cover with its existing provenance and label synthetic data and actions.
Do qualify the actual MCP App host and real player paths separately from source checks and the synthetic gallery.
donts: Don’t import the website’s display typography or Studio’s legacy eyebrows into the kit.
Don’t replace a library-only recording with a catalog candidate to make a control available.
Don’t invent artwork, metadata, duration, volume, connected status or a completed account action.
Don’t expose Cider queue access when the current profile lacks the queue tool.
Don’t claim a QUALITY BAR comparison, actual-host qualification or release readiness from this documentation.
